senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Jethro, the father-in-law of Moses.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 27:9">Ex. R. s. 27</cite> <he>יֶתֶר כשהוא גוי … ונקרא י׳</he> as a heathen he was named Jether, and when he was converted … he was named J.—

<cite ref="Zevachim 116a:21">Zeb. 116ᵃ</cite> <he>י׳ קודם מ״ת וכ׳</he> the arrival of J. (<cite ref="Exodus 18:10">Ex. XVIII</cite>) took place before the giving of the Law; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 24a:20">Ab. Zar. 24ᵃ</cite>; a. v. fr.
